tools.name: create_enterprise_document
tools.description: Create a new knowledge-base document in a Gitee enterprise. Returns the created document_id, which you can pass to the other document tools. This creates an empty document; add content with upload_enterprise_document_files or update_enterprise_document_page. Creation may initialize the document repository asynchronously.

auth_type.description: Access scope: inherit, private, read_only, or read_write. Default: inherit.

parent_id.description: Parent folder's doc_node id. Omit to create at the enterprise knowledge-base root.

program_id.description: Program ID returned by list_programs, to create the document under a program knowledge base. Omit for an enterprise-level document.

scrum_sprint_id.description: Scrum sprint ID. When set, the document is created under the sprint's folder and program_id is required.

tools.name: create_enterprise_document_node
tools.description: Create a page or folder inside an existing enterprise knowledge-base document. Set type to "page" or "folder". Omit parent_id to create it at the document root. A new page starts empty; read it with get_enterprise_document_page to obtain its version, then add content with update_enterprise_document_page.

parent_id.description: Parent folder's page_id returned by list_enterprise_document_pages. Omit to create at the document root.

type.description: What to create: page for a page, folder for a folder.

tools.description: Create an issue in an enterprise

priority.description: Priority (0: Unspecified, 1: Trivial, 2: Minor, 3: Major, 4: Critical)

tools.description: Create a pull request for repository in an enterprise

tools.description: Create a repository in an enterprise

import_program_users.description: Whether to import program members: 0: No, 1: Yes

issue_template.description: Whether to initialize issue template: 0: No, 1: Yes

project_public.description: Whether public: 0: Private, 1: Public, 2: Internal Open

pull_request_template.description: Whether to initialize PR template: 0: No, 1: Yes

readme.description: Whether to initialize readme: 0: No, 1: Yes

time_scale.description: Time Scale, unit: hours, support two decimal places

tools.name: download_enterprise_document
tools.description: Export an enterprise knowledge-base document and save it to the machine running the MCP server. Markdown and HTML exports may produce ZIP files; PDF exports produce a PDF file.

format.description: Export format: markdown, html, or pdf. Default: markdown.

output_directory.description: Absolute destination directory on the machine running the MCP server.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing file with the same name. Default: false.

tools.name: get_enterprise_document_page
tools.description: Get the complete content and metadata of one page in an enterprise knowledge-base document. Use list_enterprise_document_pages first if the page_id is unknown.

include_rendered_html.description: Include rendered HTML in addition to the source content. Default: false.

version.description: Historical version or commit ID. Omit to read the latest version.

tools.name: list_enterprise_document_pages
tools.description: List all pages and folders in an enterprise knowledge-base document. Call this before reading or updating a page to resolve its page_id and current version.

document_id.description: Document ID returned by list_enterprise_documents. Do not pass document_node_id or page_id.

tools.name: list_enterprise_documents
tools.description: List knowledge-base documents accessible to the authenticated user in a Gitee enterprise. Use the returned document_id with document page, upload, download, and update tools. A listed document may still be read-only. This does not list repository Wikis or uploaded attachments. With search set, the tool returns page-level keyword hits (each hit carries its document_id and page_id) instead of the flat document list, and program_id, created_by_me, direction, and per_page are not supported.

created_by_me.description: Return only documents created by the authenticated user. Default: false.

direction.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Default: desc.

program_id.description: Program ID returned by list_programs. Omit to list enterprise-level documents.

search.description: Keyword to search. Matches document names and page names; page content is searched only when the server has full-text search enabled. Mutually exclusive with program_id, created_by_me, direction, and per_page.

sort.description: Sort field: name, created_at, or updated_at. Default: updated_at.

tools.name: list_enterprise_groups
tools.description: List groups in an enterprise

per_page.description: Number of items per page, default 20

sort.description: Sort field (created_at: created time, updated_at: updated time)

tools.description: List comments of an issue

created_at.description: Creation time, format: (interval)yyyymmddTHH:MM:SS+08:00-yyyymmddTHH:MM:SS+08:00, (specific date)yyyymmddTHH:MM:SS+08:00, (less than specified date)<yyyymmddTHH:MM:SS+08:00, (greater than specified date)>yyyymmddTHH:MM:SS+08:00

filter_child.description: Whether to filter subtasks (0: No, 1: Yes)

finished_at.description: Task completion date, format as above

issue_state_ids.description: Task status IDs, multiple selection, separated by commas.

kanban_column_ids.description: Kanban column IDs (multiple can be selected, separated by commas)

state.description: Task status attributes, multiple can be selected, separated by commas. (Open: open Closed: closed Rejected: rejected In Progress: progressing)

per_page.description: Number of items per page, default 20

sort.description: Sort field (created_at: creation time, remark: enterprise remark, role: role, occupation: position, block_status: block status)

priority_topped.description: Whether to sort by priority first

tools.name: rename_enterprise_document_folder
tools.description: Rename a folder in an existing enterprise knowledge-base document. This endpoint handles folders only; to rename a page, pass page_name to update_enterprise_document_page instead.

name.description: New folder name. Must not contain '/', must differ from the current name, and is limited to 64 characters.

tools.name: update_enterprise_document_page
tools.description: Replace the complete content of one page in an enterprise knowledge-base document. Read the page first and pass its current version; the tool re-reads the page and rejects content that is already stale before submission. The content parameter is a full replacement, not a patch.

commit_message.description: Short description of the change recorded in document history.

content.description: Complete replacement page content in the content_type returned by get_enterprise_document_page. This is not a patch; an empty string clears the page.

expected_version.description: Current page version returned by get_enterprise_document_page, used for a preflight stale-content check.

mentioned_user_ids.description: Enterprise user IDs returned by list_enterprise_members to mention in the updated page.

page_name.description: New page name without a parent path. Omit to keep the current name.

tools.name: update_enterprise_issue
tools.description: Update an issue in an enterprise

estimated_duration.description: Estimated duration (in hours, supports two decimal places)

priority.description: Priority (0: Unspecified, 1: Trivial, 2: Minor, 3: Major, 4: Critical)

tools.name: update_enterprise_pull
tools.description: Update a pull request in an enterprise

tools.name: upload_enterprise_document_files
tools.description: Upload and import local ZIP, HTML, TXT, or Markdown files into an existing enterprise knowledge-base document. This adds pages to an existing document; it does not create a new document. Each file must be no larger than 6 MiB.

document_id.description: Target document ID returned by list_enterprise_documents.

file_paths.description: Absolute paths on the machine running the MCP server. Supported extensions: .zip, .html, .txt, and .md. Imported content may contain at most 20 pages.
